The job failed before xcodebuild ran, so there is no build or install log.

This is a runner fault, not the code: CI compiles the same commit on GitHub's
runners, and signing and the phone are only reached later in this job.

The one seen here: `##[error]Missing file at path:
<runner>/_temp/_runner_file_commands/set_output_<uuid>` during Checkout — the
runner lost the temp file backing $GITHUB_OUTPUT mid-step. Causes, in order:

  1. **Two runner processes sharing one installation directory** — confirmed
     here by the companion error `The file '<runner>/_diag/pages/<id>_<id>_1.log'
     already exists.` A page log is named for the job, so a collision means two
     listeners in one folder, each clearing _temp and _diag under the other.
     Almost always the service and an interactive `./run.sh` both alive, which
     the setup note at the top of this file invites by offering them as
     alternatives.
  2. The runner service restarting, or the Mac sleeping, mid-job.
  3. Something outside Actions clearing the runner's _temp directory.

Fix for (1), on the Mac, and only the Mac's owner can do it:

    ps aux | grep -i '[R]unner.Listener'      # expect exactly one
    cd ~/actions-runner && sudo ./svc.sh stop # then kill any stray ./run.sh
    rm -rf _diag/pages                        # stale page logs
    sudo ./svc.sh start                       # one listener, service only

Then re-run: Actions ▸ Deploy ▸ Run workflow.

⚠️ The `concurrency` group above serialises *runs*, which stops two deploys
overlapping — it does **not** stop two listeners racing inside one install
directory. Do not read a green deploy after this commit as evidence (1) is
fixed; the duplicate process has to be cleared on the Mac.
